title: query-table field schema
description: A dataset's field schema: the single source of truth that codegen projects into the TS catalog (@pythia-software/query-table-core FieldDef[]) and the backend schema (backends/go FieldSpec). Backend-specific SQL lives under each field's `bindings`, so non-SQL/non-Go backends can bind the same document later.

name.description: Dataset id; also the StorageAdapter namespace for saved queries.

idField.description: Field whose value is a row's stable id (selection, per-row refresh).

defaultSort.description: ORDER BY applied when the query's orderBy is empty.

tiebreakSort.description: Always appended after the user's sort so paging is deterministic (e.g. [{field:id,dir:asc}]).

defaultSelect.description: Visible columns when the query's select is empty (in display order).

field.description: One field. `source` says WHAT KIND of field it is (the value origin + server capability); `filter`/`sort`/`select` are declarative capability config; `render` is a registry key the frontend resolves to a renderer; `bindings` is the backend SQL.

name.description: Canonical id; matches Where/OrderBy field + the backend binding key.

source.description: Value origin. String shorthand or object. Omitted ⇒ inferred: `backend` if `bindings` present, else `derived`. (A derived field's `accessor` is code and is attached at runtime, never in JSON.)

path.description: Dotted path into the API row when it differs from `name`.

synthetic.description: Computed SQL with no backing column.

pushdown.description: Evaluate on the backend? Default backend ⇒ true. false ⇒ applied client-side by applyQuery.

field.description: Server field to ORDER BY when it differs from the display field.

enabled.description: Can it be a visible column? Default true. false ⇒ filter-only.

default.description: Shown when the query's select is empty.

aggregate.description: Capability config for the aggregation/metrics add-on. Backend fields only.

measure.description: Can be a metric's measure (sum/avg/min/max/count_distinct)? Default: backend ⇒ true.

groupable.description: Can be a GROUP BY key? Default: enum/text/bool ⇒ true.

ops.description: Override the default aggregate-op set for the field's type.

alias.description: Single alternative search term (legacy alias support).

aliases.description: Extra search terms for the picker.

render.description: Render-registry key resolved on the frontend (code, not data — only the key is stored).

bindings.description: Per-backend binding, keyed by backend id so one schema can serve several backends.

filterValues.description: How filter-value candidates are offered. Default everywhere is autocomplete (backend distinct-value search, refined per keystroke).

expr.description: Server-defined SQL expression (e.g. "r.commit_id" or "(r.stats->>'duration_ms')::numeric"). NEVER derived from request input — it and the validated operator are the only request-influenced tokens that reach SQL; values are always bound parameters.

synthetic.description: Computed expression with no backing column (e.g. "(w.tags ? 'rerun')").

kind.description: SQL coercion path. Defaults to the field's `type`; override when the column's SQL type differs.
